newsitem.title: JAPAN: Yaohan seeks longer payment period to suppliers.
newsitem.headline: Yaohan seeks longer payment period to suppliers.

text.p: Major Japanese supermarket chain operator Yaohan Japan Corp said on Thursday that it had asked its wholesalers and other suppliers to accept a longer delay before they are paid.
A Yaohan official said the company asked its 477 suppliers if it could extend the time-lag between merchandise delivery and payment to two months from the current one month.
"This is only a change in how we conduct business," said a Yaohan official. "We are making the system closer to the industry standard," he added.
The official also denied rumours that the company faces a financial crunch because of the redemption of warrant bonds worth about 12 billion yen on December 10.
The official said that the company hopes to apply the new system starting from the end of this month.
Shares in Yaohan fell 100 yen on Thursday, closing at 441 yen.
